description: Shorten a markdown or text prompt without losing instructions. mode standard (default) is a free deterministic pass that saves a new version unless dryRun is true; requires files:write for API keys. mode deep starts an AI compaction job that uses credits, verifies every instruction was kept, and never saves on its own: poll the returned job, then call rubrkit_apply_deep_compaction; requires compactions:run for API keys.
name: rubrkit_compact_artifact_file
title: Compact artifact file
